To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the IoT is a promising platform for building advanced applications and that it requires a solid foundation in the area of data processing and semantics.
the Internet of Things is an emerging technology that will have a major impact on how we live our lives and how we do business.

1) IoT applications require semantic models for describing the data and its context; 2) IoT applications need to be able to reason and extract information from the data; 3) IoT applications need tools to integrate and analyze the data from multiple sources; 4) IoT applications need methods to manage large-scale data; and 5) the IoT data needs to be linked with other data to provide more context.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and application of semantic technologies to IoT applications, and in this tutorial we aim at providing an introduction to the state-of-the-art and future directions for this research area.

the IoT data is a valuable resource that needs to be managed, integrated, annotated, and analyzed for building advanced applications and knowledge-based systems.

we are developing tools and techniques for the semantic annotation and integration of heterogeneous IoT data, and the development of AI applications for the extraction of knowledge from the data.

semantic technologies are essential for IoT and PCS systems to enable interoperability, integration, and knowledge extraction from the IoT data.
